name: What is the difference between home maintenance and a full interior remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between home maintenance and a full interior remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance focuses on preserving and repairing existing features, while remodeling involves altering structural layouts or completely replacing living spaces. For example, repairing damaged drywall, swapping a cracked bathroom tile, or fixing a door frame is maintenance. In contrast, gutting a bathroom down to the studs for custom tile installations, new framing, and updated vanities is a remodel. The practical tradeoff is budget versus longevity: regular maintenance keeps functional spaces presentable at lower cost, but when materials are degraded across an entire room, a full remodel often proves more cost-effective over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Maintenance fixes and preserves existing components, while remodeling involves reconfiguring layouts, rebuilding structures, and replacing entire rooms.
